summary.headline: Happiest Minds Q2 FY27 revenue rose 12.5% YoY to INR 645 crore, with operating margin up to 18.5% from 17.5% in Q1.
summary.overview: Q2 FY27 revenue was INR 645 crore, up 2.7% QoQ and 12.5% YoY in rupee terms (6.8% YoY in constant currency). Operating profit rose 22.4% YoY to INR 119 crore, with margin up 100 bps QoQ to about 18.5%, helped by higher IP-led revenue and utilization of 81.8%. Growth was led by IMSS, which management attributed to annuity deals and security demand, while US geo was flat at 0.9% QoQ. DSO rose to 101 days from 92, and the proposed combination with ITC Infotech is progressing with a targeted completion around October-November 2027.

financial_highlights.change: +2.7% QoQ; +12.5% YoY in INR; +2.4% QoQ and +6.8% YoY in constant currency
+13.4% YoY in INR; about +6.8% in constant currency

segments.name: IMSS (Infrastructure Management and Security Services)
segments.commentary: Sharp sequential growth driven by annuity deals (3-4 in the US, a Middle East conglomerate, a large Indian bank) and security demand; about 40% of IMSS revenue is from security. ELLIPSE platform has about 21 customers onboarded.

segments.name: Geography
segments.commentary: Americas about 56% of revenue; US geo grew 0.9% in the quarter. APAC grew about 10% sequentially and rose to 9% of revenue; India contributed 18%.

segments.name: Industry verticals
segments.commentary: BFSI is the largest at about 28% of revenue. Retail and CPG, high tech and industrial showed sequential momentum; healthcare and EdTech remain part of the portfolio.

segments.name: Generative AI Business Services (GBS)
segments.commentary: Grew about 135% YoY in constant currency in H1 FY27, from a relatively small base.

segments.name: IP-led revenue
segments.commentary: Improved to 10.5% of revenue from 9.3% in Q1, aided by Rel(AI)Build, ELLIPSE and SecAIGenie.

guidance_outlook: Proposed combination with ITC Infotech is on track; management expects the merged company by October-November 2027, subject to approvals.
Stated aspiration of US$1 billion annual revenue for the combined enterprise by FY28.
Management expects the ESOP scheme for top talent to be repeated next year, in consultation with ITC Infotech.
Priority for the ongoing quarter is improving DSO from 101 days.
Management aims to return ROCE and ROE to roughly 24% and 15-16%, alongside operating margin and utilization gains.
capex_capacity: Utilization improved to 81.8% from 81% in Q1, close to an all-time high for the last 5-6 quarters.
Voluntary attrition improved to 14.3% from 15.4% in Q1.
Project Reimagine launched to shift from effort-based delivery toward outcome-based customer value engineering.
55% of projects are delivered with AI-enabled delivery; 72% of developers and testers use advanced AI tools.
demand_pricing: Customer count at 311 active customers; 95 billion-dollar corporations (up from 92 in Q1); large enterprises contribute almost 60% of revenue; repeat business 95.1%.
Enterprise tech spending described as selective, with a focus on measurable outcomes in the near to medium term.

Notable Q2 wins: multimillion-dollar BOTAT GCC engagement with a global digital asset management firm, a steel manufacturer digital planning platform, an Indian commercial vehicle maker's connected-vehicle programme, a cloud engineering deal with a global electronics distributor, and a multiyear managed services deal with a US skin care company.
Management said AI-enabled productivity let it bid more aggressively than competitors on fixed-price deals.
US EdTech revenue (about 90% of EdTech from the US) remained weak, and some high-tech customers completed projects or ran out of funding, weighing on US growth.

qa_highlights.question: Why has US market revenue been flat at US$38-39 million per quarter for six quarters, and what is being done to revive it?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said US geo grew 0.9% in the quarter and bookings were positive, with US wins from NN logos. Drag came from US EdTech weakness and completed or underfunded high-tech projects. EduWeave is targeted at Middle East, India and Southeast Asia universities.

qa_highlights.question: Is the IMSS jump recurring or project-based, and how much is cybersecurity?
qa_highlights.answer: Ram Mohan said the growth came mainly from annuity deals, with about 40% of IMSS from security. Some revenue also shifted from Q1 to Q2, and SecAIGenie is gaining traction.

qa_highlights.question: What drove IP-led revenue growth?
qa_highlights.answer: Management cited ELLIPSE (about 21 customers) and SecAIGenie, along with Rel(AI)Build adoption by about 15 customers.

qa_highlights.question: Is there a revised retention or incentive structure ahead of the merger?
qa_highlights.answer: Joseph Anantharaju said an ESOP scheme for top talent was introduced last year and earlier this year, with a similar scheme planned next year, to be discussed with ITC Infotech given the standstill period.

qa_highlights.question: Why is overall EBITDA margin flat while segment margins improved, given unallocable expenses?
qa_highlights.answer: Venkat Narayanan said the company-level operating margin rose from 17.5% to 18.5%. Segment margins are shown only to gross margin, and corporate costs sit in unallocable. IP-led mix and utilization drove the gain.

qa_highlights.question: What is the merger timeline and the shareholding path?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the merger goes through CCI and shareholder approvals, then NCLT. A separate SPA between ITC Infotech and promoter Ashok Soota covers two 11% tranches, the first after CCI approval and the second after shareholder approval around February-March. Completion is targeted for October-November 2027.

risks_watch: Merger execution risk: CCI, shareholder and NCLT approvals, with completion targeted for October-November 2027.
DSO rose to 101 days from 92 due to Aureus and PureSoftware migrations; management has made improvement a priority.
US growth remains flat, with EdTech weakness and high-tech project completions as drags.
Net treasury and borrowing cost: forward premiums (about 5.5% annualized) and mutual fund yields (about 1.6-1.7% this quarter) affect other income.
AI-driven pricing pressure on fixed-price deals and the shift toward outcome-based models.
summary.management_tone: Confident on operating performance and margin gains, but cautious on the US market and the broader macro, which management called mixed. Management was relatively evasive on the merger's exact share-transfer timing and on the specific dollar size of the IMSS and IP-led wins.
key_quotes: We delivered another quarter of healthy growth and improved operating performance.
Operating margins have improved by 100 basis points sequentially to about 18.5% compared with 17.5% in Q1.
Happy to say that we are on track and if everything goes continues in the same way, we should be a merged company by October-November of next year.
Almost 40% of our IMSS business comes from security.

growth.why: No explicit FY27 revenue growth guidance was restated (management said only it is broadly on track); utilisation rose to 81.8% and the quarter's 12.5% YoY revenue growth (6.8% in constant currency) is backed by annuity deals and IP mix, but no specific capacity, orders or contracts with numbers were given, and the ITC Infotech merger and $1bn FY28 aspiration are not capacity.

rows.label: Margin expansion
rows.why: Operating margin rose 100 bps QoQ to about 18.5% (from 17.5%) on IP-led mix (10.5% of revenue, up from 9.3%) and utilisation of 81.8%, with management aiming for further margin gains.

rows.label: Volume growth
rows.why: Constant-currency growth was 6.8% YoY and 2.4% QoQ, US geo grew only 0.9% QoQ and EdTech remains weak, while annuity deals and IMSS wins support volumes.

rows.label: New capex announcement
rows.why: Utilisation is 81.8%, which is high, but the call gave no capex plan and management's focus is on the ITC Infotech merger and DSO, so a capex announcement is not signalled.

rows.label: Guidance upgrade
rows.why: No explicit FY27 revenue guidance was restated, only that the company is broadly on track, and US growth is flat at 0.9% QoQ.

rows.label: Guidance downgrade
rows.why: US growth is flat for six quarters at about US$38-39 million, EdTech and high-tech project completions are drags, and management called the macro mixed.

rows.label: New product launch
rows.why: Rel(AI)Build, ELLIPSE (about 21 customers), SecAIGenie gaining traction and EduWeave targeting Middle East, India and SE Asia universities, though no dated launches were given.

rows.label: ITC Infotech merger completion
rows.why: Merger targeted for October-November 2027 subject to CCI, shareholder and NCLT approvals, with ITC Infotech's SPA for two 11% promoter tranches, the first after CCI approval and the second around February-March.

rows.label: DSO reduction from 101 days
rows.why: DSO rose to 101 days from 92 on Aureus and PureSoftware migrations, and management named improving DSO as the priority for the ongoing quarter.

rows.label: GBS growth from small base
rows.why: Generative AI Business Services grew about 135% YoY in constant currency in H1 FY27, but from a small base with no revenue figure disclosed.

tone.note: Management was confident on margin gains (17.5% to 18.5%) and IMSS annuity deals, but cautious on the flat US market (0.9% QoQ) and the macro; analysts probed US revenue stagnation, IMSS recurring versus project revenue, and merger timing, which management answered only partly.
